title: Time to Computed Tomography and Association With Survival in Indian Trauma Patients
brief_summary: The study aims to assess whether time to CT is associated with survival in adult trauma patients in an urban lower-middle income setting.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Direct admission to the participating centre (not referrals)
* Patient is 15 years or older
* CT imaging was conducted as part of the trauma workup
study_population: Adult trauma patients undergoing CT at four public university hospitals in urban India
